actual_scope: Does the first simple reflection that moves a punctured line of the #7007 P112 frame induce the same weight-16 set equality after the 112-line list is rebuilt and the seven recorded supports are transported?
scope_change_reason: The replay-runtime card asks for a measured speedup. The revision-8 verification row says a published faster replay is not equivalent coverage until checked. Open PR #7007 recorded the unreflected P112 equality and asked whether one simple reflection preserves it after transport. This package answers that question for the first moving pair. It does not time an engine or rerun the unreflected census.
bottleneck_link: Frame-code coverage checks remain usable only when the low-weight set still matches after the root list changes. This comparison binds the seven recorded supports to one reflected P112 frame. It does not change a supplier bill or the selected kappa.
stop_rule: Stop after the first simple reflection that moves a punctured line, one rebuilt 112-line list, and one half-split compared with the transported supports. Do not test another simple root, rerun the unreflected census, or call the bit-lane or intersection-counter engines.
evidence: The first simple root in the pinned E8 system that moves a punctured line is alpha=(1,-1,-1,-1,-1,-1,-1,1), acting on (2,-2,0,0,0,0,0,0). The image frame fixes four punctured lines and moves four, and it is a different orthogonal 8-frame. The rebuilt 112-line complement has SHA256 a2ac7049d9eef1cff8af1eec35b084e6d261efad5311625e5356cceafe260da7. Transporting the seven recorded supports gives SHA256 9ce7e5edc72ee3104d62cb068146b73840e9a3c42c4132403dece70c8146cccb. The incidence matrix has 1260 rows, rank 76 and kernel dimension 36, with free coordinates distinct from the unreflected basis. One half-split after 18 generators visits all 68719476736 kernel words and returns exactly those seven weight-16 supports. The weight distribution equals the distribution recorded for the unreflected frame. The seven untransported integers fail frame parity. Selected kappa stays 781451/250000000.
